hero.title: The story behind Claude Science
hero.subtitle: A customizable research workbench built for the tools scientists already use.
intro.body: Claude Science integrates the tools and packages researchers most often use, purpose-built for scientific research workflows. Here is how a typical research task flows through it, from raw data to a reviewed, reproducible result.
steps.title: How it works, step by step
item-1.title: Connect your environment
item-1.body: Point Claude Science at a laptop, HPC cluster, or Modal account over SSH to manage compute jobs directly.
item-2.title: Bring your data and packages
item-2.body: Claude Science works with the notebooks, packages, and pipelines your lab already relies on.
item-3.title: Run the analysis
item-3.body: Claude executes code, iterates on results, and tracks the exact environment behind each output.
item-4.title: Review is built in
item-4.body: A background reviewer flags incorrect citations or untraceable numbers before you see the result.
item-5.title: Get a reproducible artifact
item-5.body: Every output ships with the exact code, environment, and conversation that produced it.
